selection.scope: each image and each scale independently
selection.ordering: first-stage error descending; exact ties use ascending raster/flat token index
selection.threshold_definition: minimum selected error (the K-th largest); at K=0 use nextafter(max_error,+inf)
selection.implementation_note: Dense depth-two indices are cached once for an exact rate-distortion scan; the selected output is numerically equivalent to sparse lookup but this evaluation does not measure sparse-lookup runtime.

transport.representation: fixed first indices + one-bit explicit mask per token + fixed-width active second indices
transport.logical_frames_per_image: first_s0, first_s1, mask_s0, mask_s1, second_active_s0, second_active_s1
transport.mask_decode_rule: Map A_tx decoded refinement indices onto received-mask active positions in raster order; truncate surplus payload or zero-fill surplus received active positions.
transport.framing_metadata: segment boundaries, shapes, K, and original source lengths are assumed known out of band
transport.mask_error_note: Residual mask errors can shift compact active-index assignment within one scale; independent frames prevent cross-scale and cross-image propagation.
